entities.name: Query MurE ligase
observations: 490 aa soluble enzyme; predicted molecular mass 54.6 kDa and pI 5.79.
Matches reviewed MurE homolog A4IM04 at 70.1% identity over 99.2% query coverage with E-value 3.3e-249.
Contains Pfam Mur_ligase PF01225, Mur_ligase_M PF08245, and Mur_ligase_C PF02875 domains.
Likely ATP-dependent UDP-MurNAc-L-Ala-D-Glu meso-diaminopimelate ligase; assignment is strongly supported by homology and domain architecture.

entities.name: MurE
observations: Requires ATP and Mg2+; curated homolog annotations include ATP binding and magnesium ion binding.
A conserved N6-carboxylysine modification is reported in homologs, but the query residue modification is not experimentally established.
